auditNotes: Full built-in name and dispatch audit of tracked Semoss/src/prerna, active ReactorFactory registrations, expression aliases, and frame variants. Concrete discovery includes classes outside reactor/ and classes without a Reactor suffix.

Read constructors, inherited and parameterized/varargs constructors, aliases, reachable noun-store/positional readers, execute return producers, PixelStreamUtility, and relevant Gson adapters. Constructor key lists and MCP default schemas were not treated as sufficient contracts.

Source-base contracts preserve finite keys, proven required groups, positional minimums, and proven outer output shapes. Semantic input values and nested/opaque output shapes remain explicit follow-ups, not fully verified contracts. Only separately proven source omission is allowed; optional fields alone do not make parameters optional.

The 104 audited name contracts cover the documented common reactors and expression aliases. Select/Filter/Join intentionally expose positional forms; inherited named qs merging remains a subtype-sensitive frontend follow-up.
ClassGraph 4.8.184 registration order was verified from bytecode and actual factory maps. Effective collision winners and shadowed implementations are recorded in the inventory.

Existing Semoss configuration, project assets, and tests and Monolith web.xml deployment changes were preserved. No built-in Semoss src files were locally modified, and this sync made no backend edits.

Top-level built-in expected-success typing preserves current envelopes, nullability, errors, and delayed entries. Project overrides and query-parent expression dispatch can differ from these top-level contracts.
The repository already stores sync state at root semoss-sync.json; added this independent target there and preserved targets.api unchanged.

Follow-up output audit traced inherited wrappers into concrete helper implementations, SQL row mappers, DTOs, provider normalization, and Gson/Pixel wire adapters. Output-only refinements preserve the existing input contracts and public surface; runtime-dependent values and remaining unverified nested fields are tracked separately.
reactors.coverageSemantics: Base source-output counts retain the constructor/execution inventory baseline. Final counts resolve audited input contracts plus output-only implementation refinements. Known outer output includes the never type of a reactor with no successful return. Runtime-dependent payloads are separate from remaining unverified nested shapes; output audits do not imply verified input values.

backendFindings.finding: Integer noun consumers truncate literals outside the signed 32-bit range
backendFindings.sourceEvidence: Semoss/src/prerna/reactor/expression/OpBasicMath.java:108 uses Number.intValue(); negative-literal paths also coerce integer nouns.
backendFindings.consequence: Raw SUM(2147483648) returns -2147483648 and SUM(4294967295) returns -1. The builder emits decimal literals for whole numbers outside the signed 32-bit range; backend probes verify the corrected values.

backendFindings.finding: Integer-only arithmetic results can overflow even when every operand fits in 32 bits
backendFindings.sourceEvidence: Semoss/src/prerna/reactor/expression/OpBasicMath.java:87 casts integral all-integer results to int.
backendFindings.consequence: SUM(2147483647,1) returns 2147483647. A decimal operand avoids that path, but preserving ordinary integer noun semantics means a generic builder cannot repair every reactor arithmetic operation. Backend remediation is needed.

backendFindings.finding: write emits a root string FUNCTION followed by an object; a direct default-Gson probe produced "FUNCTION"{}, invalid JSON.
